cot.note: Weekly COT, Tuesday positions, released Friday. Net is non-commercial longs minus shorts. Report date 2026-11-03. FX rows are legacy financial futures, commodity rows are the legacy combined file.

sources.yahoo: Yahoo Finance chart API, no key, range 1y daily. Unofficial and indicative, not execution grade.
sources.ecb: ECB daily euro reference rates, no key.
sources.fred: FRED fredgraph.csv, attempted with 12s timeout. Timed out from this VM on Nov 11, 2026 (curl HTTP 000, three variants), so Yahoo yields are the primary rates source. The FRED API needs a free 32-character key.
sources.cot: CFTC Commitments of Traders, free weekly text files: FinFutWk.txt for FX, deacom.txt (legacy combined) for commodities. Retried Nov 11: both return HTTP 200; the earlier 403 was transient and the parser bug (startswith on quoted lines) is fixed.
sources.treasury: US Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve Rates TextView page, no key. The yield.csv URL 404s, the HTML table parses cleanly and is the only free source found for the 2Y yield.
